_comment: Add any sensor MAC IDs you want to track live here. Both formats work: 'B0-BC-82-C4-C4-41' or 'B0BC82C4C441'.
_trackingOutput: Tracking logs are written to .logs/_TRACKING_<MAC-ID> as the server runs.
_columns: Each log line is a JSON object with: timestamp, portReceivedOn, siteName, parsedValues, alertEvaluation, and optionally eventType='MESSAGING_DISPATCH' for WhatsApp/Telegram records.
